collection.description: A miner with aching joints wonders whether to keep working underground.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A miner with aching joints wonders whether continuing underground is bravery or stubbornness.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The miner becomes an admired instructor, though they miss the tunnels.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: They remain productive for a time, but must periodically reassess their limits.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: They become a surface prospector and discover a talent for teaching geology.
